text: Entry Requirements 1. Basic Eligibility: (1)Non-Chinese citizens holding foreign passports. (2)High school graduate or above, with eligibility for university application. (3)Physically and mentally healthy, with no criminal record. 2. Nationality Eligibility *This only applies to applicants who were born to parent(s)with Chinesecitizenship at the time of birth. According to the < Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China > and the relevant provisions issued by the Ministry of Education of China:(1)For applicants who were born in a foreign country and have acquired foreigncitizenship at birth, The applicants’parent (Chinese-citizen side) must have had obtained foreign permanent residency before the applicants’birth. In addition, the applicant must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinesemainland/long Kong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). (2)For applicants who have emigrated from China and have acquired foreign citizenship. The applicants must have obtained foreign nationality before May 1, 2022. and completed formalities for renouncing the Chinese citizenship. In addition, the applicants must have a record of actual residence abroad(outside Chinese mainland/ong Kong/Macao/Taiwan) for at least 2 years between May 1, 2022, and April 30, 2026 (calculated in cycles from May 1 to April 30 of the following year, 9 months of actual residence per cycle counts as one year, verified by entry/exit stamps). 3. Language certificate and score report (HSK). Level 5 (score 210 or above) orLevel 6 (score 180 or above). This is NOT mandatory. 4. Required Subjects for the CSCA Test, download here . Note: (1) The program is designed for international students only; (2) Change of major is not allowed.
